race.comment: CROWN MINT (6) doesn't win out of turn but also isn't doing a lot wrong. Boasts peaks that stack up and could take some holding out under the light weight of the 3kg claim. SPANGLED SIPPER (10) has caught the eye in both runs back and while she's likely to drift back again, if the pace is genuine she can cause some grief for her rivals. ROGUE WARRIOR (15) brings strong Vic formlines across and should be at his absolute top now fifth-up. Have to include. CRADLE OF JAZZ (3) is airborne as he shoots for the hat-trick here. Stead has piloted him in his last two from tricky gates. Can he rinse and repeat? MR GEORGE (8) was good first-up without threatening. Never looked likely last start but can get things back on track third-up. A must for wider exotics at a big quote.
